content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Digital product

The infrastructure of a digital product store without KYC payments is a game-changer for creators. By utilizing crypto payment processing through NOWPayments, anyone can sell digital products directly to consumers without the constraints of traditional payment platforms. This approach circumvents the high fees associated with platforms like Gumroad, which charges 10% on every sale, allowing creators to retain significantly more revenue. For example, with 100 sales of a $97 product, the fee difference translates to a retention of $921. This model empowers creators to fully control their sales channels and profits.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of a no-KYC digital product store is built on robust and reliable technologies. Using platforms like Cloudflare Pages for hosting and Cloudflare Workers for backend processing, creators can easily manage their storefronts. Orders are stored using Supabase or Google Sheets, providing a simple yet effective database solution. File delivery is automated through Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, ensuring customers receive their purchases instantly. The integration of NOWPayments enables automatic on-chain payment verification, eliminating the need for intermediaries and ensuring that creators can accept over 300 cryptocurrencies.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is designed specifically for digital creators operating in environments where access to conventional payment platforms is restricted. Whether you're selling ebooks, online courses, or digital templates, this solution is tailored to meet the needs of individuals in countries such as Nigeria, Ghana, and Venezuela. By opting for a no-KYC payment system, these creators can avoid the complexities and frustrations associated with traditional financial institutions, making it easier to focus on their craft and reach a global audience.
Cut platform fees with NOWPayments' 0.5% charge compared to Gumroad's 10%.
The Components That Make It Work Together

A successful no-KYC digital product store comprises several essential components working in harmony. The hosting solution—either GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages—ensures your site is available to customers worldwide. The backend logic is managed by Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, which automates crucial processes like order fulfillment. Supabase or Google Sheets acts as a reliable database for order management, while Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 delivers files seamlessly to customers. With NOWPayments handling the payment processing, this entire stack is designed for efficiency and reliability, allowing every digital creator to operate independently.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To set up your digital product store, follow these steps: First, choose your hosting solution—GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, configure your backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Set up your database with Supabase or Google Sheets to store order information. Prepare your digital files for delivery via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Finally, integrate NOWPayments for seamless payment processing and choose your preferred cryptocurrencies. For a comprehensive setup guide, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197) which includes all necessary blueprints and templates.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

The fastest path to your first sovereign digital product sale is a three-step process. First, create a NOWPayments account — configure your wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as starting points, generate your API key, and set the webhook endpoint URL. Second, choose your stack: Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages plus Google Apps Script and takes most creators four to six hours following the Sovereign Blueprint at $47; Stack 02 uses Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase and is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours with the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Third, upload your product files, set your prices in USD, and run a complete mainnet test transaction before promoting.
Complete ownership of your store means no one can take your profits.

This kit includes all 6 blueprints and 7 templates needed to create, deploy, and scale your sovereign digital commerce stack seamlessly. Explore more at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Choose your hosting solution between GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Pages. Set up backend logic with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Organize your order database using Supabase or Google Sheets. Upload your digital files to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for delivery. Integrate NOWPayments for crypto processing to finalize your store setup. Test the entire workflow to ensure seamless operation.
